summary: Car plunged off a section of Pikes Peak Highway known as the Bottomless Pit, went through a stone barrier and caught fire after falling down a steep cliff; ambulances on scene and a helicopter called in to transport one person; condition not reported.
location: Pikes Peak Highway, Bottomless Pit area
